ratings.comment: If you are looking for a class where you will be seen and valued as a student, take his class. As a professor, he cares about student learning and well-being and wants everyone to do well. His lectures are engaging and insightful, and the readings actually aid class learning. There is no busy work, and all assignments have a clear purpose.

Edgar is an amazing professor! I took this class to fulfill my ethnic credit, but the topics were very interesting to learn about. We do have 2-4 readings per week and a response, but overall, it isn't a lot of work and is easily doable. His lectures are more talk than note-taking, but also engage with current events, videos, and documentaries.
Awesome, kind, keeps everyone engaged because hes funny, and truly cares about what he is teaching

Taking this class during the summer session at an accelerated pace, he delivers inspirational lectures and reduces the assigned reading to prioritize mental health. If you want to learn about education policies, I recommend taking a class with him!

Edgar is an awesome professor and he very clearly cares about his students and their perspectives. He always finds a way to make class interesting, whether it be through music, art, or current events. Papers and writing are about experiences within education and your opinions. So far this class has been an absolute joy to take.

Mr.Valles clearly cares more about the students than anything else. He welcomes different points of views that people have. I would recommend this professor to anyone. The only issue I ever had this semester was the lecture held the day after the President Election. It was clear that political views were showing, which I do not admire.
Professor creates a welcoming atmosphere and makes class material engaging.
